rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement structure and contents caused by a burst supply line in their home is direct property damage to the insured premises.
claim_summary: Policyholder returned from a work trip to find their basement flooded with approximately two inches of water caused by a burst supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot, and multiple ruined stored boxes. Estimated damage likely exceeds $25,000; requires prompt on-site assessment and water mitigation coordination.

case_facts.damage_description: buckled hardwood floor, drywall soaked to one foot, ruined stored boxes
case_facts.discovery_context: discovered upon return from work trip
case_facts.water_source: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is a classic property damage claim.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee reports wind damage to four shingles on the back porch overhang with estimated repair cost of $400. No interior water damage or other structural impact. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will likely be non-covered, but routed for adjuster confirmation and discussion of coverage options.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind; no interior water damage
